release_notes:
Vortex PT 1.5.1 Table Export Customizer, Custom Vector Icons & Silent Updates:
• Table Export Filtering: Columns toggled OFF in the UI are cleanly excluded from both CAD Shop Drawing cutting schedule tables and Excel export sheets.
• Column Toggle Switches: ON/OFF toggle switches beneath each column header and interactive header clicking to toggle export states.
• Custom Vector Icons: Distinct high-DPI and SVG vector icons for Live Anchors, Dead Anchors, and Pan Boxes.
• Zero-Click Silent Auto-Update: Downloads and installs updates in-place automatically without installer wizard dialogs.
• 3-Strand & 5-Strand Column Split: Separate columns for 3-strand and 5-strand chairs in both Live End and Dead End chair tables.
